prompt: Single game hero sprite: A determined, serious, mature female tide-mage, drawn as a chunky heroic cartoon character about 3 heads tall: a BIG head about one third of the whole figure height, a stout body with broad round shoulders, big sleeves, ENORMOUS fists (each fist almost as big as her face), short thick legs and big heavy boots, a wide planted stance, never cute, never a mascot. Her face is built from the fewest bold shapes: a thick angular dark brow shape, TWO BOLD GLOWING pale-gold eye shapes with no pupils as the brightest points of the face, a small light-tan nose shape, a firm jaw, a firm mouth line, the skin in two flat tones; her hair is a thick long braid over one shoulder drawn as a few big solid clumps, dark brown, with a coral-coloured hair band. TWO ARMS OF EXACTLY THE SAME SIZE AND LENGTH and TWO LEGS OF EXACTLY THE SAME SIZE AND LENGTH. SIGNATURE: on her shoulder on the RIGHT side of the image she wears ONE giant spiral nautilus-shell shoulder guard in cream, as big as her whole head, fixed to her robe; her shoulder on the LEFT side of the image has a smaller round teal plate. She wears a chunky teal robe with big wide sleeves, a wide brown leather belt with a wooden buckle and a hanging coral sash, a hem of big scalloped wave shapes with a cream lining, wooden bracers on EACH forearm (identical on both arms), and a thick boot with a wide cuff on EACH leg (identical). In the hand on the LEFT side of the image (her own right hand) she holds ONE oversized driftwood staff: a thick knotted dark-wood haft about as tall as her head plus a little more, and at the top ONE large spiral nautilus-shell head in cream holding ONE big glowing pale pearl, with a small fan of coral branches under the shell; held by a huge clearly visible gripping fist at about the height of her hip; the hand on the RIGHT side of the image is empty, a huge relaxed fist the same size as the staff hand. COLOUR PLAN with strict harmony: ONE dominant hue, a sea teal (hue about 185 degrees), used in four values only: shadow #1B4650, base #2C7C84, light #6DB8B4, top highlight #C4E6DC. ONE warm family for the skin, the leather, the belt, the boots, the bracers and the staff haft: sand-tan skin #C98A55 with shadow #8E5A3A and light #E8B684, woods #7A4E31 and #4B2F20. Cream #EFE2BE with warm-grey shadow #BFAE8A ONLY for the shell shoulder guard, the staff shell and the hem lining; the pearl and the eyes in pale warm gold #FFF1C9. ONE small accent family, coral #E2674B with shadow #A8432F, ONLY on the sash, the hair band and the coral branches. Rules: large areas are mid values; only the eyes, the pearl and the small coral accents are strongly saturated; every shadow is a darker tint of its own colour, never black; every light is a warmer, paler tint of its own colour, never pure white; the outline is a dark mauve-brown #2B1E22. NEAR-FRONT VIEW from a high top-down camera: the body faces the viewer and is turned only about 20 degrees toward the RIGHT of the image, the face looking slightly right, the whole chest visible. BOTH ARMS are fully visible and the same size, neither hidden; BOTH LEGS are fully visible, the same size, neither hidden. Not a flat profile, not a straight front view. Standing UPRIGHT in a calm, strong idle stance with a living pose: the body upright, the head tilted about 8 degrees toward the right of the image, her left shoulder about 5% of the figure height lower than the right, both feet planted wide apart, side by side on ONE horizontal ground line, the right arm hanging down at her side away from the body; the staff stands beside her left hand with the butt of the haft on the ground line, the haft tilted about 8 degrees so that the shell head leans toward the upper-left of the image, the whole staff clear of the legs and fully inside the frame with the top of the shell at least 8% below the top edge. Full body, centered, filling about 64% of the frame height. At most four colour families. Everything stays inside the frame with margin on every side. Background: one flat solid pure magenta color (#FF00FF) everywhere, no gradient, no ground, no cast shadow, no scenery, no text, no border. Do not use magenta or pink anywhere on the subject. Style: stylized 2D vector cartoon game art for a fantasy tower defense game, in the manner of a chunky heroic cartoon hero illustration, designed to read at about 60 pixels tall. Chunky rounded bean-like volumes with slight squash and stretch, big simple shapes with a bold silhouette, exaggerated proportions with the hands, shoulders and the staff head enlarged and the legs shrunk. Colour: flat solid fills in 3 to 4 stacked hard-edged tones (a shadow tone shifted toward a cooler hue, the base, a lighter tone, and one bright highlight shape on top), with the large areas kept in MID values so the figure stays readable when shrunk; no gradients, no airbrush, no painterly texture, no noise, no realistic rendering. Thick clean dark mauve-brown outlines (never pure black), clearly thicker on the outer silhouette and thinner for inner lines, with rounded joins. A few small flat speckle spots of a lighter or darker tone are scattered on the robe and the skin. Medium detail only: details are bold simple shapes (one shell, layered cloth, a sash, a pearl), no fine engraving, no filigree, no tiny patterns, no thin lines. High top-down camera tilted about 60 degrees; light comes from the top-left.
